braise.title: Fire, chilli and patience.
braise.text: The chicken is butterflied, marinated, then grilled over the coals. The piri piri sauce is made in-house: it has been our signature since 2022. And we ask you just like in Portugal: with or without?

specialites.title: Bacalhau, like at home.
specialites.text: Philippe Salgado grew up around Amiens, in a family that came from Portugal in the early 1970s. On the menu: bacalhau à Brás, pastéis de bacalhau, febras, chouriço. The dishes families share on a Sunday.

items.q: Do I need to order ahead?
items.a: It's not required, but it's quicker: order online or by phone and choose your pick-up time. For a whole chicken at peak times, allow 30 minutes.
Yes, you can eat at the restaurant. Choose “Eat in” on the form if you order ahead.
At the counter when you collect. Accepted payment methods are to be confirmed with the restaurant (card, cash, meal vouchers).
You choose: mild, normal or extra hot. The sauce can also be served on the side.

items.q: Do you cater for parties and groups?
items.a: Yes: whole chickens, grills, pastéis de bacalhau and pastéis de nata. Ask for a quote at least 2 days ahead, online or by phone.
The restaurant is at 2 ter rue de l'Eau in Pont-de-Metz, 10 minutes from Amiens. There is street parking nearby.

sections.p: Le Piri Piri opened in Pont-de-Metz in 2022. Behind the counter is Philippe Salgado, whose parents came from Portugal to the Amiens area in the early 1970s. The food is what families eat together: simple, generous, homemade.
Piri piri chicken over coals, febras, espetada, entremeada, chouriço assado. For fish lovers, salt cod: bacalhau à Brás, grilled cod, pastéis de bacalhau. And a pastel de nata to finish.
Order online or by phone, choose your time, come and collect. For parties and groups, we prepare whole chickens and platters on quote.

piripiri.lead: Butterflied, grilled over coals, homemade piri piri sauce.

sections.p: In Portugal, when you buy a grilled chicken, they ask: with or without piri piri? Same here. The chicken is butterflied, marinated, grilled over the coals, then brushed with our homemade chilli sauce.

sections.h: Whole, half or as a plate
sections.p: A whole chicken feeds 3 or 4. A half chicken is a meal for one, with homemade fries and Portuguese rice. The piri piri plate puts it all in one box.
Choose your pick-up time online and the chicken will be ready. For a birthday or a match, order several whole chickens at least 2 days ahead.

faq.q: Where can I get piri piri chicken in Amiens?
faq.a: At Le Piri Piri, 2 ter rue de l'Eau in Pont-de-Metz, 10 minutes from central Amiens. Eat in or takeaway.

faq.q: Can I choose how spicy it is?
faq.a: Yes: mild, normal or extra hot, and the sauce can be served on the side.
